source.attribution: Lauren Walters, Matthew J. McDermott, Bernardus Rendy, Yuxing Fei, and Gerbrand Ceder, Precursor Genome (2026), Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory.

endpoint.name: formation of at least one phase incorporating ions from both precursors
endpoint.transformed_semantics: Negative only for the cross-precursor-product endpoint; a transformed-only sample may contain oxidation, reduction or decomposition products and is not chemically inert.
endpoint.physical_failure_semantics: A sample not recovered as a characterizable powder is excluded, never treated as a negative reaction.
endpoint.poor_refinement_semantics: An active refinement with human quality score 3 is excluded, never treated as a negative reaction.

thermal_metadata.warning: Do not reconstruct the experimental dwell temperature from precursor.melting_point_c. The paper's reference temperature is the first thermally accessible transition (which may be melting, decomposition, reduction, sublimation or phase transformation); the proxy reference temperature used in model features is a further decomposition-product adjustment.
thermal_metadata.paper_dwell_rule: T_dwell = 100 * floor((2/3 * min(T_ref,1, T_ref,2))/100), clipped to 200..1100 °C.
thermal_metadata.audit_policy: The v0.1 auditor reports the recorded dwell field and missingness but does not infer missing values or use nominal setpoint as a measured thermal history.

claim_ceiling: Public-dataset provenance, graph-completeness and cohort-reconciliation audit only. No new reaction-onset prediction, synthesis recommendation, phase-yield claim or material discovery is established.
